author: Bloomberg
title: Blinkit CEO warns India’s quick commerce bubble may be close to bursting
description: A model that has so far relied on relentless fundraising is nearing its limits and companies will soon have to decide how long they can keep absorbing steep losses, says Blinkit Chief Executive Officer Albinder Dhindsa
content:
The head of Indias biggest quick commerce player says the sector is hurtling toward a shakeout as rivals cash dries up, but that his startup will thrive and continue its expansion.
